topic: Portkey Akto AI Gateway Guardrails Guide 2026

competitors.title: What's an Agent Gateway?
key_points: Agent gateway sits between agents and everything they call (LLM providers, MCP tool servers, sub-agents) as a dedicated infrastructure layer
Six production problems solved: credential sprawl, multi-provider reliability, scoped access control, guardrails at every hop, bounded spend, full-chain observability
Portkey's three-product architecture: AI Gateway (routing/reliability/cost), MCP Gateway (tool credential injection/permissions), Agent Gateway (A2A proxy/registry)
Agent runs are not LLM transactions — a single run spans multiple providers, tool calls, and sub-agent delegations
Guards apply to inputs AND outputs at every step, not only on the response reaching the user
OTEL-compliant traces group every model call, tool invocation, and sub-agent delegation under one run ID

competitors.title: Open Sourcing Guardrails on the Gateway Framework
key_points: Portkey processes billions of LLM tokens daily, helping hundreds of companies bring AI apps to production
Guardrails integrated into the gateway enable real-time orchestration of LLM requests based on guardrail verdicts
Key missing component: LLM outputs remain unpredictable — hallucinations, bias, privacy violations, harmful content
Partnership model with specialized guardrails platforms (Guardrails AI, NVIDIA NeMo, etc.) rather than building in-house
Interoperability, routing, and guardrails combined on the gateway is the architecture for production AI

competitors.title: AI Guardrails for LLMs and AI Agent Security
key_points: Five guardrail categories: Data (training/RAG validation), Model (system prompt hardening), Input (prompt injection detection, content classification, context isolation), Output (PII/bias/hallucination detection), Operational (RBAC, rate limiting)
Runtime guardrails are the most critical: real-time prompt injection detection, output policy enforcement, tool call authorization, anomaly alerting, audit logging
Three attack categories: prompt injection (direct + indirect), data exfiltration, jailbreaking, plus agentic AI vulnerabilities (privilege escalation, task hijacking)
Six design principles: defense in depth, least privilege, auditability, adaptability, contextual filters, allow/deny lists
Akto provides real-time MCP/AI agent discovery, automated red teaming with 1,000+ probes, and granular policy-driven guardrails
Shadow AI is an expanding blind spot — guardrails must detect unauthorized tool/MCP integrations outside IT governance

competitors.title: Guardrails AI Blog — MLflow Integration and AI Safety
key_points: Guardrails AI provides deterministic safety validators, PII detection, and quality checks as GenAI scorers
Integration with MLflow for evaluation workflows enables running guardrails validators as scoring functions
Snowglobe simulation environment for testing LLM apps against real-world user behavior before deployment
NVIDIA NeMo Guardrails integration for comprehensive AI safety combining two frameworks
